name: phishguard-extension
description: Extension PhishGuard (Chrome MV3) : analyse locale des URLs, sans envoi de données.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.store:assets: node build.mjs --test && playwright test -c store/playwright.config.ts && node store.mjs
scripts.lint:firefox: npm --prefix tools/web-ext exec --no -- web-ext lint --source-dir dist-firefox --warnings-as-errors
